changelog:
• 🎬 Native Trailer Playback: Background trailers now play through the native video engine instead of a WebView — smoother, lower memory use, and no more mismatched or stale trailers
• ⚡ Faster & Smoother: Baseline profile plus targeted optimizations cut cold-start time and make home-screen scrolling noticeably smoother on low-end Android TV
• 🏠 Smarter Home: Opens on Continue Watching (or Movies), the Movies/Series shortcuts map to your Indian catalog, and your scroll position, selection and paging are preserved when you return from a title
• ▶️ Cleaner Player: Streamlined icon-only controls with the clock at the end, and no leftover frame from the previous video when starting a new stream
• 🔎 Refreshed Design: New blended background across all pages, restyled search bar, uniform category tabs, and redundant back buttons removed (use the remote's Back)
• 🐛 Fixes: Stream-card D-pad navigation, trailer now stops the moment playback starts, and no unwanted trailer autoplay when returning to the home grid
